messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in place, turning the body and head to look around while making small hand gestures near the chest.","camera":"A static, slightly high-angle full-body shot keeps the figure centered in the frame.","clothing":"Wears a yellow and white patterned long-sleeve sweater, blue jeans, and brown lace-up shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a small top-knot bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult figure with a medium-brown complexion and a slim build.","scene":"The figure stands on a cracked concrete surface in bright sunlight, casting a long shadow to the left, with a low wall and a red object visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a medium close-up at roughly chest height to a static high-angle full-body shot. The character is centered, seen from head to shoes, with the same sweater, jeans, bun, and gestures. The background is now mostly open cracked concrete with a long shadow, while the original Ferris wheel and carousel are no longer visible except for a small red object at the upper right.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a high-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, matching the reference for viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the new background is the same environment viewed from a different angle or a simplified replacement scene.
unexpected_changes: The original amusement-park background elements (Ferris wheel, carousel, striped cart) are largely removed from view, leaving a mostly empty concrete area.
